notes: The source page is for the Applied Ocean Science and Technology, Associate in Science Degree, not the Marine Conservation & Monitoring Certificate of Achievement. The text has no section for the certificate, so no blocks, total, outcomes or careers are recorded for it.

The text includes the A.S. degree's overview, program learning outcomes and Plan of Study Grid. It does not include the requirements tab. The A.S. degree's outcomes and careers (deckhands, naturalist, environmental education positions) were not recorded, because they belong to a different award.
The Plan of Study Grid opens by referring to 'the certificate', but it is the A.S. degree's map: it totals 60-61 units and includes GE areas.
A reviewer should find the correct catalog page for the Marine Conservation & Monitoring certificate.
